facts_from_code: get_definitions exposes located term names, surrounding sentence text and coordinates.
DefinitionCaught coordinates are built from term matches; they are not a complete ContractNLI evidence set.
The default document route calls sentence segmentation; sentences.py loads sentence_segmenter.pickle with joblib.
Definition parsing may normalize quotes/braces and unidecode text; original coordinate fidelity would need explicit verification.
The repository declares AGPLv3 default licensing; no code was copied and no project license or dependency was changed.
useful_seam: Explicit referenced-term to defining-source provenance may reduce lexical overlap mistakes such as disclosing-party versus receiving-party Representatives. This remains a hypothesis, not a deployed skill or measured gain.
rejected_direct_integration: Do not treat a located term or entire containing sentence as all legal evidence, do not introduce a new segmentation model, and do not silently union definition spans into answers.
